{"subject":"Scaling 2B shipment-tracking events/day","body":"Hi Joris,

Lumen Logistics' shipment-tracking service writes 2B events/day to DataStax Enterprise 6.8, and your team is focused on modernising that cluster and reducing operational toil. With IBM having completed its DataStax acquisition, it may also be a natural moment to review options.

ScyllaDB delivers higher throughput per node, which typically means fewer nodes and lower infrastructure cost for a write-heavy workload like yours.

Would it be worth comparing notes on what that could look like for your cluster?

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB
